Clause 3.4.1 - height_limit (development_control): See relevant zone objectives and height control maps

Clause 3.4.2 - fsr_control (development_control): See relevant zone objectives and floor space ratio maps

Clause 3.4.3 - setback (development_control): See relevant zone objectives and setback maps

Clause 5.1 - heritage (heritage): Development should preserve items of heritage significance

Clause 6.2 - parking (development_control): Adequate parking must be provided on site to meet the needs of the development

Clause 3.1 - zoning (land_use_zoning): Development must be consistent with the objectives of the applicable zone.

Clause 7.3 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): Development must minimise impacts on waterways and native vegetation.
